messages:
Anya: Heads up — flying out of SFO tomorrow red-eye. Any late-night snack recs around Mission Bay / SoMa for a 10pm pickup? Also what are the best grab-and-go options inside SFO (T3)?
Miguel: Sandwich Spot on 3rd is open late, get the turkey + avocado. :drooling_face:
Samir: +1 Sandwich Spot. If you want something lighter, Taco Corner on 4th has horchata jars to go.
Liz: For airport, I usually grab Illy coffee + almond croissant at Blue Bottle near security in T3. Also Bites & Flights has pre-packed salads.
Cheng: There's a new kiosk 'Sky Bento' near gate F18 in T3 — decent bento boxes, not overpriced.
Anya: @Miguel can you swing by if you have time? fam needs a protein hit.
Miguel: I can do 9:30pm pickup. Anyone else want anything? reply with emoji: :sandwich: for sandwich, :taco: for tacos, :bento: for bento, :coffee: for coffee/croissant.
Liz: :coffee:
Samir: :taco:
Cheng: :bento:
Anya: :sandwich:
ops-bot: Reminder: last MUNI outbound from Mission Bay at 11:15pm today. Plan accordingly. :bus:
Anya: thx ops-bot — I'll aim for 9:45 meetup by the cafe.
Miguel: I'll DM pickup list. Also pro tip for SFO: security food hall on the south side restocks around 10pm, sometimes better than kiosks.
airport-bot: Flight check — Anya UA 123 at 01:10 local, gate TBD. Please allow 90min for domestic evening boardings.
Liz: Omg the croissant is warm if you ask. also smallish but value.
Samir: If anyone wants to pre-order, here's the Sandwich Spot menu: https://sandwichspot.example/menu (they do curbside).
Anya: cool — sending Venmo to whoever picks up. thanks y'all! :heart:
Miguel: got the list, leaving in 20.
